title: Minimal blind BEV_RU reliability exercise
hypothesis: Independent coders can distinguish OCC, FUL and VAL above the frozen threshold.
counter_hypothesis: The distinction collapses after target masking or genre control.

unit_of_analysis.context_rule: At most one neighboring sentence on each side within the same document.
unit_of_analysis.stable_id_rule: SHA-256 of corpus, document, position, query and SNAP date.

codebook.question: Did an occurrence take place?
codebook.positive_criterion: The context asserts that an event happened.
codebook.boundary: Do not infer fulfillment or institutional validity.

codebook.question: Was a possibility or plan realized?
codebook.positive_criterion: The context asserts realization or fulfillment.
codebook.boundary: Do not infer legal or normative validity.

codebook.question: Was the event institutionally recognized as valid?
codebook.positive_criterion: A legal, administrative or conventional status is conferred.
codebook.boundary: Do not infer physical non-occurrence from invalidity.

sampling.population: Licensed corpus contexts containing target event predicates.
sampling.deduplication: Keep the lexicographically first stable ID per identical context.

blinding.risk_tested: Whether the scene rather than the target word is coded.

metrics.measure: Krippendorff alpha, nominal, with bootstrap 95% CI
metrics.fail_action: Do not call the codebook reliably reproducible.

negative_tests.fail_action: Downgrade the distinction to lexical cue dependence.

kill_criteria.condition: Nominal alpha or its lower CI falls below the frozen threshold.
kill_criteria.action: Merge, revise or remove the failed distinction before a new preregistration.

data.note: Fixture deliberately models a blocked empirical run.

deviation_policy: Preserve the frozen plan; record every change as a new plan version and a path-level deviation.
